profile:
COMPANY NAME: Teradata
INDUSTRY: Data Analytics & Artificial Intelligence
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: An Autonomous Knowledge Platform that integrates data, AI, and analytics to automate business decisions and actions in real-time. It offers a full-stack solution including cloud, on-premises, and hybrid deployment options for building, activating, and managing AI agents and workflows.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Large enterprises in highly regulated industries, specifically banking, airlines, telecommunications, logistics, healthcare, automotive, life sciences, and manufacturing.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise (Fixed + Flex hybrid model)
KEY FEATURES:
- Autonomous Knowledge Platform for real-time decision automation
- Unified AI environment for building, activating, and managing AI agents
- Multi-modal data integration to create high-quality knowledge context
- Flexible deployment options (Cloud, On-premises, and Hybrid)
- Fixed + Flex pricing with a unified "Teradata Unit" currency for cost transparency
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS:
- Combines predictable fixed costs with elastic flex capacity to avoid over-provisioning
- Single unified currency (Teradata Unit) for compute, storage, software, and AI
- Focus on "autonomous" execution where AI agents act on data without human intervention
- Trusted by top-tier enterprises in highly regulated sectors (e.g., 10 of top 10 banks)
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Premium
